task.title: GitHub Action: build a benchmark for a requested format
task.description:
## Why
The benchmark crawl stays in Python because it runs for many minutes and already works. Running it from a workflow means nobody needs a local setup to add a format.

## Steps
1. Add a workflow, started by hand, that takes a league id of the wanted format.
2. Run the existing Python pool crawl and benchmark build for that format.
3. Open a pull request adding the resulting file to `benchmarks/`. It holds aggregate tables only, so it is safe to publish. The league id must not appear in the pull request.
4. Add a second trigger that refreshes the existing benchmarks once a season.

## Done when
- Running the workflow for a new format produces a pull request with its benchmark file.
- After merging and deploying, a league of that format shows percentiles.
